mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the load was most worthwhile: the planned panels connect muscle stretch, sensory feedback and motor output to an observable adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the spindle and sensory fiber was less engaging on its own: the coiled ending was clear, but the spindle's function was not explained until later.

surprise.text: The later explanation clarified that muscle spindles report stretch; their role was not obvious from the initial spindle picture alone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though several were the only offered combination, so following them did not require discovering compatibility.

continue.text: I would cautiously continue: the final load example usefully connects the constructions, although the intermediate steps were mostly linear. The supplied illustration plans alone do not establish how well students would understand them.
